- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.3) — reduce forecast by 2–5% relative to sentiment peak.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (sentiment < 0.1) — add 3–7% to forecast to compensate for mean reversion bias.
- Overshoot after sharp price spikes — cap forecast 3–5 days post-spike at 10–15% below peak.
- Lagged mean reversion: if 10+ days of downward trend, forecast should not drop below 10% below 30-day moving average.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to overreact to short-term sentiment — dampen forecast by 10–15% if sentiment is volatile or recent.
- If sentiment is flat (0.0–0.1) and price is trending, assume no significant change — forecast should align with 14-day moving average.
